"""Write two session reports with v0.1-m14's own writer (run with PYTHONPATH=<v0.1-m14 tree>)."""
import logging
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pam.execute.reporter as reporter
from pam.execute.apply import ApplySummary

out = Path(sys.argv[1])
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
assert "m14src" in reporter.__file__, reporter.__file__
log = logging.getLogger("gen")

clean = ApplySummary(
    session_id="s-20261101-101500", renamed=3, approved=3, elapsed_s=0.4,
    archive_root=Path(r"C:\Users\user\Pictures\Archive"), plan_id=4,
    started_at="2026-11-01T10:15:00",
)
reporter.write_session_report(out, clean, log)

messy = ApplySummary(
    session_id="s-20261102-091200", renamed=2, approved=4, not_approved=1, elapsed_s=1.2,
    stranded=["2019-07-04_001.JPG"], recovery_notes=["IMG_9.JPG needs your attention."],
    archive_root=Path(r"C:\Users\user\Pictures\Archive"), plan_id=7,
    started_at="2026-11-02T09:12:00",
)
messy.record_failure("IMG_2.JPG", "pam could not rename this file.")
reporter.write_session_report(out, messy, log)
